prompt: Show prices including tax on the receipt: add `lines_with_tax()` (each line's name and tax-inclusive price in cents) and `total_with_tax()` to Receipt.

review.intent: Tax is rounded on each line, and the receipt total is the sum of the printed lines, so the receipt adds up for the customer. Taxing the subtotal once can make the total a cent or more off the sum of the lines.
review.correction: Round tax on each line, and make the total the sum of the printed line prices, so the receipt adds up. Don't compute the total by taxing the subtotal separately.
